answer: Bind each earning vertex to a secure chip that signs an epoch-specific pseudonym derived from its manufacturer-certified device secret. Reject duplicate pseudonyms, so a vine of accounts on one chip shares a single reward slot. A quartz oscillator is cheap; the scarce item is the certified chip, which a farm must buy for each extra slot. Cap rewards below hardware rental cost. This only raises Sybil costs: compromised vendors, rented chips and exclusion of low-budget agents remain weaknesses.
